# Variable `IMAGE_BUILDINFO_VARS`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

When using the image-buildinfo class, specifies the list of variables to include in the Build Configuration section of the output file (as a space-separated list). Defaults to “DISTRO DISTRO_VERSION”.

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-IMAGE_BUILDINFO_VARS)
